spanish: Y tú, toma a ti aromas principales: mirra fluida quinientas, y canela aromática su mitad cincuenta y doscientas, y caña aromática cincuenta y doscientas,

findings.issue: רֹאשׁ is masculine singular construct and heads the following מָר, but the Spanish makes it the plural adjective principales of בְּשָׂמִים and leaves the myrrh without that head.
מָר is construct and דְּרוֹר is an absolute noun; fluida turns that noun into a liquid adjective and closes the lemma.
The construct noun בֶּשֶׂם/בֹשֶׂם, same lemma as aromas, is smoothed into the adjective aromática.

notes: The 2ms address, imperative, ethical dative, and the five-hundred and fifty-and-two-hundred counts match the tokens.
